body:
New PARENA/stdlib/reflux/reflux.prn: real cross-mod pub/sub via a shared append-only action log (VS0 has no function pointers/closures for true callbacks). bloodflower_mod.prn now dispatches a real action on moon-zenith; new, separate bloodflower_hostile_spawner_mod.prn subscribes and spawns 5 real hostile Living Map creeps (faction 3/Corruption's first live use) at map center -- zero direct calls between the two mods. New arena_daynight_light_dir ports SHANKPIT's real dynamic sun/moon light direction (only the ambient tint was ported before; the 3D scene light was a hardcoded constant). Live-verified: real fast-forwarded server + 2 bots completed a full match; a longer headless run drove a full day/night cycle confirming both bloodflower behaviors fire. 20 new tests, full suite green (3189 assertions). ECOWAR commit cfb3d19, PARENA commit 83c1680.

⚓ ☃
title: REFLUX cross-mod pub/sub + real Bloodflower hostiles + day/night lighting
